functions.name: ApplyBlendWeight
functions.docs: Applies weighting to this view, in order to be blended with another one. Equals to this *= Weight.

functions.name: AddWeightedViewInfo
functions.docs: Combines this view with another one which will be weighted. Equals to this += OtherView * Weight.

functions.name: CalculateProjectionMatrix
functions.docs: Calculates the projection matrix using this view info's aspect ratio (regardless of bConstrainAspectRatio)

functions.name: CalculateProjectionMatrixGivenView
functions.signature: CalculateProjectionMatrixGivenView(View Info, Aspect Ratio Axis Constraint, Viewport, In Out Projection Data)
functions.docs: Calculates the projection matrix (and potentially a constrained view rectangle) given a FMinimalViewInfo and partially configured projection data (must have the view rect already set)

functions.name: CalculateProjectionMatrixGivenViewRectangle
functions.signature: CalculateProjectionMatrixGivenViewRectangle(View Info, Aspect Ratio Axis Constraint, Constrained View Rectangle, In Out Projection Data)
functions.docs: Calculates the projection matrix (and potentially a constrained view rectangle) given a FMinimalViewInfo and partially configured projection data (must have the view rect already set). ConstrainedViewRectangle is only used if the ViewInfo.bConstrainAspectRatio is set.

functions.name: GetFinalPerspectiveNearClipPlane
functions.docs: The near plane distance of the perspective view (in world units). Returns the value of PerspectiveNearClipPlane if positive, and GNearClippingPlane otherwise

functions.name: AutoCalculateOrthoPlanes
functions.docs: Automatically calculates the Near/Far plane values for an Ortho camera

functions.name: SetCameraToViewTarget
functions.docs: Sets the camera distance from view target for AutoCalculateOrthoPlanes

functions.name: TransformWorldToFirstPerson
functions.signature: TransformWorldToFirstPerson(Target, World Position, Ignore First Person Scale)
functions.docs:
Transforms a world space location into "first person space". This function mirrors the morphing that is applied to first person primitives
when they are rendered on the GPU, so it can be used for spawning objects (e.g. projectiles or ejected shell casings) relative to the morphed
first person geometry on screen.
Setting bIgnoreFirstPersonScale to true only applies the field of view morphing and is useful for cases where a full size projectile is spawned in front
of the first person weapon. By ignoring the first person scale for the spawn location, the spawned full-size projectile will be spawned a bit further away from the camera,
but its on-screen size will look correct.

functions.name: CalculateFirstPersonFOVCorrectionFactor
functions.docs:
Correction factor to apply to the first person transform used on primitives tagged as "IsFirstPerson" to achieve a first person specific field of view.
It is computed as tan(SceneFOVRadians * 0.5) / tan(FirstPersonFOVRadians * 0.5).

functions.name: ApplyOverscan
functions.signature: ApplyOverscan(Target, In Overscan, Scale Resolution With Overscan, Crop Overscan)

functions.name: ApplyAsymmetricOverscan
functions.signature: ApplyAsymmetricOverscan(Target, In Asymmetric Overscan, Scale Resolution With Overscan, Crop Overscan)

functions.name: GetOverscan
functions.docs: Gets the total amount of overscan that has been applied to the view's frustum, with 0.0 meaning no overscan and 1.0 meaning 100% overscan

functions.name: ClearOverscan
functions.docs: Removes all overscan (uniform and asymmetric) from the view info.
